envelope.description: Supply concise previous-round feedback and verify recovery end to end

body.title: Supply concise previous-round feedback and verify recovery end to end
body.summary: Project explicit previousRoundFeedback into attribution and assessment inputs using latest applicable same-reviewer unresolved failures. Exclude previews/raw errors/schema repetition from this property and raw diagnostics from embedded history. Complete provider/host/recovery and subsequent valid feedback tests, preserve old failed attempts, and document the new input and diagnostic boundaries.
acceptanceChecks: Next inputs contain pointed attempt/task/phase/code/field/correction data; assignments are task-scoped and attribution selected-scope, within the 4 KiB prompt budget with explicit truncation.
Latest same-party resolved results suppress older errors; absent/foreign historical diagnostics produce empty feedback without guessing or backfill.
Synthetic Claude/Codex runs prove rejected feedback -> durable checkpoint -> concise next input -> independently schema-valid next feedback on both host routes, with byte-identical earlier attempts.

Disconnect/restart, shared attribution, writer failure and accepted-feedback precedence tests preserve existing invariants. Documentation updated; no hosted S2 retry or legacy review invocation is part of this build.
Document optional diagnostic data compatibility, old strict-reader downgrade limitations and no stripping/backfill of immutable history.

tests.name: previousRoundFeedback is concise, scoped, bounded, excludes previews/schema and respects latest same-party resolved result
Fake Claude/Codex failure persists on daemon route and appears in subsequent input
Saved diagnostics survive disconnect/restart; later valid feedback does not rewrite failed attempt
Writer failure does not falsely acknowledge diagnostics; accepted feedback survives later wrapper failure
